image_description: A modern interior staircase featuring a sleek metal bannister system. The railing consists of a continuous, rounded black handrail supported by vertical cylindrical balusters and horizontal bars, following the incline of wooden stairs. A large newel post anchors the bottom left, while the railing curves gently at the top landing. The background includes a brick column, glass partitions, and a white wall with signage.
